author: _Windows_95_
body:
Minecraft name: ChallengerPvP

I would like to make a ban appeal as I was recently banned permanently off Avicus Network for apparently using KillAura. 
However, I was not using any cheats and I would never risk my Minecraft account of fear of the consequences.
The only mods I was using is OptiFine which I believe is permitted for use on the Avicus Network.
I believe the banning me off the server was an error, which is why I am submitting this ban appeal.

Thank you for your time.

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: LFT
replies.body:
After looking at the video and getting a few staff members opinions, I have decided to deny this appeal. 


I'll be leaving this appeal unlocked for the next 24h or until requested.

Video Proof

replies.author: _Windows_95_
replies.body:
This is probably due to the fact that I am in Australia, and the ping to US servers are quite bad here. I suggest that bad latency may have contributed to the suspicious nature of the video.
I think that you should take some time to improve your anticheat system as it may be detecting incorrect cheating, for example if a player was banned falsely.

If this server had competent staff members, the decision to ban me would never had been made.
Thank you for your time.
